(butacaine) Profile Butacaine, a para-aminobenzoic acid ester, is a local anaesthetic (p.1850) used for surface anaesthesia. It has been used topically, as the sulfate, in solutions for dental pain and in ear and nasal drops. (butoxycaine) Profile Butoxycaine, a para-aminobenzoic acid ester, is a local anaes- thetic (p.1850) that has been used as the base or hydrochloride for surface anaesthesia.
